dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: *sigh* There are more important things we could be doing...

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: I'm a photographer from The Steambird. I'm here with Houallet for an interview.

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: But really, this case just looks like a series of coincidences — if we're unable to interview the fugitive involved, there'll be nothing to write about, really.

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: That "Monsieur" has quite the good temper, to be going along with Houallet like that.

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: Well, the case went like this...

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: The "Monsieur" tripped a thief who had stolen a wallet with a crowbar.

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: The wallet contained a picture taken by the owner of the wallet, and in the background of that photo was a criminal on the run.

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: ...And yeah, that's how evidence fell from the skies, enabling the Maison Gardiennage to catch a fugitive.

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: The culprit has already been locked away in the Fortress of Meropide — hardly a convenient interview subject. As such, there's really no opportunity to dig any deeper.

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: I know that Houallet knows this as well, but he just doesn't want Charlotte to score the monthly reprint slots with her stories again.

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: See you. To be honest, I'd have left myself if it wasn't for work.

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: Oh, interested in this title, are you? This is the term of address given to distinguished Honored Citizens of Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: These titles are gained by valiant deeds that aid investigations that make great contributions to defending the peace in Fontaine, much like that dear "Monsieur" did.

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: Not that an Honorary Citizen is very high up the "Monsieur" totem pole — as I recall, the highest you can go there is "Duke."

dialogues.speaker: Antila
dialogues.text: And that's not the sort of person Houallet can interview, I reckon.
